explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step, and zero at any D2 that reaches S2 or comes from a rare transition; it is only nonzero at D2 when a1 leads to S1 by a common transition. It peaks at about 9-10 when the previous trial was a rare a1-to-S2 trial or went unrewarded, then falls over each further run of a1-to-S1 trials (about 10, 7, 5, 3, 1), and it is larger late in the episode (trial 80 and up) and usually 0-3 before about trial 70.
